theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (ψ : Euclid n → ℝ), IsOpen V → Orthonormal ℝ τ → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ {s : Euclid n | ∑ i, s i • τ i ∈ V} → ∃ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧ tsupport f ⊆ V ∧ ∀ s : Euclid n, f (∑ i, s i • τ i) = ψ s ∧ ∀ j : Fin n, fderiv ℝ f (∑ i, s i • τ i) (τ j) = fderiv ℝ ψ s (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))
